TournamentSession.title: TournamentSession
TournamentSession.description: Shared real-time pickleball open-play tournament session containing court configuration, active round state, player roster map, and scheduled rounds map.

title.description: Display name of the open-play session.

menCourtsPhase1.description: Number of Men's Doubles courts in Phase 1 (0 to 16).

genderGamesTarget.description: Target Gender Doubles games per player (default 4).

mixedGamesTarget.description: Target Mixed Doubles games per player (default 1).

rosterMap.description: Native Firestore map of players keyed by player ID (max 150 entries).

roundsMap.description: Native Firestore map of rounds keyed by round number string (max 50 entries).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the session creator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was last updated.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Read-only marker document identifying a system administrator by UID.

/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Live pickleball open-play sessions synced across devices.
